name: Shaughnessy (riverside parkland on the North Arm of the Fraser)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Shaughnessy Golf and Country Club, Vancouver, on the low ground along the North Arm of the Fraser River near its mouth (course chat, 2026-11-13). No open orthophoto was found, so the colours are a design, not sampled: lush, well-watered championship turf a little bluer than pnw; near-white bunker sand; the water the silty grey-green of the Fraser's estuary. Trees: tall Douglas fir and western red cedar (two conifer tones by variant) with the river's black cottonwoods, bigleaf maples and red alders (trees_shaughnessy.py; a drawing choice, the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
